s: Din habborer beshabbat ubo k"t seipim: habborer hu meabot melakot, shekken bammishkan hayu borerim happesolet mittok hassamemanim. Lepikak kol habborer pesolet mittok haokel, apillu beyado achat, vaapillu kede leekol lealtar — chayyab. Abal habborer okel mittok happesolet kede leekol lealtar — eno chayyab, ella im ken borer benapa o kebara, shezzehu derek bererato. Abal im berer beqanon o tamchuy — patur min hattora, abal asur middibre soperim, gezera mishshum napa ukebara. Veim borer haokel beyado kede leekol lealtar — muttar, mippene shennetilat haokel mittok happesolet kede leoklo miyyad en zeh meen melaka kelal, shedderek akila kak hu, shehare i epshar leekol hakkol haokel im happesolet, velo asarattu tora ella laasoto bakkeli hamyuchad lekak, dehaynu napa ukebara. Abal netilat happesolet en zo derek akila, ella derek tiqqun haokel sheyyehe rauy laakila — hare zo melaka gemura. Ulepikak, apillu im haokel merubbeh al happesolet, veyesh torach yoter bibrerat haokel, ap al pi ken lo yibror happesolet apillu kede leekol lealtar:

Veken habborer okel mittok happesolet shello leekol lealtar, ella lehannicho leoklo leachar zeman, apillu bo bayyom — naaseh keborer leotzar, vechayyab, lepi shello shayyak kan lomar derek akila kak hu, kevan sheeno okel lealtar:

Veeno qaruy "lealtar" ella samuk lasseudda mammash. Abal im lo yokal ad leachar shaa — asur. Ak kol shehu samuk lasseudda — muttar libror letzorek kol otah seudda, ap al pi shettimmashek ezeh zeman. Vaapillu acherim mesubbin immo — muttar libror letzorek kullam. Veim nishtayyer mibbererato ad leachar hasseudda — en bekak kelum, kevan shebberer behetter, ubilbad shello yaarim:

En issur mishshum borer ella beborer pesolet meokel o lehepek. Abal im borer okel meokel, apillu eno chapetz leekol kelal ella echad mehem, vehashsheni notelo vezoreqo — eno niqra pesolet bishbil kak, hoil vehu rauy laakila. Ulepikak, muttar libror oto mittok haokel shechapetz leekol, veen bazeh mishshum borer pesolet mittok okel. Veim eno rauy laakila ella mittok haddechaq, ap al pi sheeno niqra pesolet gamur, veen issur bibrerato min hattora — mikkol maqom asur middibre soperim, kemo bipsolet gamur. Velaken asur lehasir healin hamuppashim min hayyaraq (sheqqorin shlaty"n), apillu im hen reuyin laakila al yede haddechaq, ella yibror hayyaraq min healin, dehaynu haokel mittok happesolet. Vetzarik lizzaher shello libror ad leachar yetziat bet hakkeneset, sheyyehe samuk lasseudda mammash, veaz muttar libror kol mah shetztzarik leekol mimmennu beotah seuddah:

Bammeh debarim amurim shemmuttar libror okel meokel? Keshehakkol min echad, abal im hayu lepanayv shene mine okalim meorabim, verotzeh libror leekol echad mehem lealtar ulehanniach hashsheni leoklo leachar zeman — hare oto hammin sherotzeh leoklo lealtar niqra okel vehashsheni chashub kipsolet. Velaken tzarik libror beyado oto sherotzeh leoklo lealtar mittok hashsheni, dehaynu okel mittok happesolet, velo lehepek. Veim borero umannicho leoklo leachar zeman, apillu lebo bayyom — chayyab:

Shene mine dagim niqraim shene mine okalim, veasur libror beyado ella oto hammin sherotzeh leoklo lealtar, velo misseudda lisudda. Veap al pi shehammin shel min echad hen gedolot venikkarot kol achat bipne atzmah, veepshar shello shayyak kan berera kelal — ap al pi ken en lehaqel, ki sepeq chiyyub chattat hu. Abal kol shehu min echad, ap al pi shebborer chatikot gedolot mittok qetannot — enah niqret berera kelal, hoil vehakkol rauy laakila veen kan pesolet. Umuttar libror bekol inyan sheyyirtzeh, apillu kede leekol leachar zeman bo bayyom. Vaapillu hayu shene minim, uborer mishshenehem yachad haggedolot mittok haqqetannot — muttar, hoil veenennu borer min echad mechabero:

Habborer turmosin mittok pesulet shellahem — chayyab, mippene shehappesolet shellahem mamteqet otam kesheyyishlequ otam immahem, umibbalade ken hem marim meod, lepikak hem chashubim pesolet, upesolet shellahem hammamteqet otam chashuba okel, venimtza keborer pesolet mittok okel, vechayyab apillu borer beyado kede leekol lealtar:

Keshem sheyyesh issur berera bookalin — kak yeshno bishar debarim hamorabim im happesolet shellahem, o shehem shene minim meorabim. Kegon im hayu lepanayv shene mine kelim meorabim, verotzeh libror min echad mechabero kede lehishtammesh bo — hare min zeh chashub keokel vehashsheni chashub kipsolet, vetzarik libror haokel mittok happesolet velo lehepek, ap al pi sheechad mehem gadol mechabero venikkar bipne atzmo. Vegam tzarik sheyyibror kede lehishtammesh bo lealtar, kemo shennitbaer bishne mine okalin:

En molelin melilot kedarkan bechol, dehaynu leshapshep shibbolim bekappot yadayv kede sheyyippol hazzera mehen, ella molel beshinnuy meat, berashe etzbeotayv. Veap al pi shemmepareq haokel mittok hashshibbolim beyadayim, vehampareq beyad hu toledet haddash bikli kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"h, mikkol maqom kevan sheeno mepareq ella kilachar yad kede leekol (lealtar) — muttar. Velo gazeru mishshum shemma yimlol kedarko, mippene sheap hammolel kedarko eno ella mepareq kilachar yad, kevan sheeno notel haokel umeporqo beyado mammash, ella shemmolel hashshibbolet vehaddagan nopel, veen derek laasot ken ella bikli hamyuchad ledisha, ella sheap al pi ken asur middibre soperim, veal yede shinnuy lo gazeru. Veyesh machmirin shello limlol kelal shibbolim shel tebua, veken sharbitin shel qitniyyot, apillu berashe etzbeotayv. Velaken asur lepareq egozim luzim o egozim gedolim mittok qelippatan haelyona hayruqqa sheal gabbe qelippa haqqasha veheaba, apillu berashe etzbeotayv. Vetob lehachamir, meachar sheyyakol leshabberan uleoklan kak belo peruq. Abal muttar leshabber veliqlop mehen qelippa haddaqqa sheal gabbe happeri tachat haqqelippa haqqasha hannishberet, sheen issur mepareq shayyak ella biqlippa haelyona. Veken muttar liqlop tebua umine qitniyyot shennimlelu mehashshibbolim vehashsharbitin meereb shabbat, raq sheyyizzaher shello yiqlop ella mah shetztzarik leekol lealtar velo kede leekol leachar shaa, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman shk"a. Abal (ledibre hakkol) asur lepareq hashsharbitin beshabbat ulehotzi haqqitniyyot mittokan (beyadayim, ki zehu mepareq gamur). Vehaolam nahagu hetter baddabar. Veyesh shellimmedu alehem zekut, kevan sheodan lachin veap hashsharbitin reuyin laakila — eno ella kemaprid okel meokel, veen bazeh mishshum mepareq, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"h. Abal mine qitniyyot sheen hashsharbitin reuyin laakila — en hetter kelal lehotzi haqqitniyyot mittokam beshabbat. Ella im ken en haqqitniyyot mechubbarot kelal bashsharbitin, shekkebar nitteqa mehem meereb shabbat, ella shehi munnachat kak betokam — azay muttar lehotziah mehem kol mah sherotzeh leekol mimmenna lealtar, abal lo kede leekol leachar shaa, mishshum issur berera:

Hayu lo chittim shennimlelu meereb shabbat mehashshibbolim, vaadayin hem meorabim bammotz — lo yenappeh beqanon o tamchuy, gezera shemma yenappeh benapa ukebara shehu chayyab. Velo apillu bishte yadayv, dehaynu lenaaran miyyad lachabertah kede lehapridan min hammotz. Ella menappeh beyado achat bekol kocho, kede sheyyeshanneh midderek hachol (velo yabo lenappot benapa):

Okel upesolet hamorabin — asur littenam bemayim kede sheyyippol happesolet lematta, kegon shehappesolet hu apar, o kede sheyyatzup lemala, kegon shehu teben. Veken hakkarshinim, en shorin otam bemayim kede lehatzip happesolet shellahem lemala, velo shapin otam beyad lehasir happesolet, mippene shehu keborer. Abal notenan bikbara, ap al pi shehappesolet nopel derek niqbe hakkebara venimtza mitbarer meelayv:

Hamshammer shemarim, dehaynu hamsannen bimshammeret — hare zeh toledet borer okel mittok happesolet al yede napa ukebara, o toledet meraqqed, vechayyab. Abal im natan bimshammeret shemarim meereb shabbat — muttar litten alehem mayim beshabbat kede sheyyachzeru tzelulin lazub:

Yayin o mayim shehem tzelulim — muttar lesannenan bimshammeret kede sheyyihyu tzelulin yoter, o apillu mippene haqqemachin sheal pi hayyayin, o shennapelu bo qissemin daqqin, veeno chashub keborer, hoil verauy lishtiyya lerovab bene adam belo berera zo. Abal besudarin asur lesannen et hammayim o yayin laban vekayyotze bahem, mishshum issur libbun, sheshsheriyyat habbeged zehu kibbuso. Mah sheen ken meshammeret, shehi asuya lekak, veeno choshesh lesochotah, vegam eno choshesh lelibbunah kelal, ulepikak en libbunah chashub kelum leesor sheriyyatah bishbil kak, ap lehaomerim sheshsheriyyat habbeged zehu kibbuso. Abal yayin adom o shekar o shear mashqin sheen melabbenin, sheen chosheshin bahem lischita mittaam shennitbaer sham — muttar lesannenan besudarin, apillu hem akurim qetzat, sherob bene adam en shotin otam belo sinnun, ap al pi ken kevan sheepshar lishtotam kak al yede haddechaq — en zo berera gemura, vehittiruhu al yede shinnuy, dehaynu besudarin. Veyesh oserim bazeh, vetob lachush ledibrehem. Abal im hem akurim legamre shei epshar lishtotam kak, o sheyyesh bahem shemarim — asur apillu besudar ledibre hakkol:

Veyayin miggitto, kol zeman shehu toses — torep chabit bishmareha venoten apillu letok hamshammeret, mippene shekkol zeman shehu toses adayin lo nipreshu hayyayin min hashshemarim yapeh yapeh vekol hayyayin kegup echad hu, veen kan borer okel mittok pesolet. Vegam hu rauy lishtiyya belo sinnun, vedarko bekak bishat haggittot shekkol hayyenot akurim verob bene adam shotin oto kak belo sinnun. Veken chometz sheggam ken darko lehishtammesh mimmennu ap keshehu ab qetzat — muttar lesanneno. Abal im hu ab harbeh sheeno rauy kelal belo sinnun — asur lesanneno apillu besudar. Veken mashqeh sheqedim ketushim meereb shabbat — muttar lesanneno, kevan sheyyekolin lishtotan belo sinnun:
Keshemmesannenin besudar mashqeh akur qetzat — tzarik lizzaher shello yaaseh guma bassudar leqabbel hammashqeh, ella yishpok alayv vehu yishqa meatzmo, kede leshannot midderek hachol:

Kol mashqeh shemmuttar lesanneno besudar — muttar lesanneno bikpipa mitzrit, ubilbad shello yagbiah hakkepipa mishshule keli hattachton tepach, kede leshannot midderek hachol. Abal oto keli heasuy kenapa umesannenin bo, hoil vehu meyuchad lekak — dino kimshammeret, sheen mesannenin bah ella mashqeh tzalul sheen bo shemarim, kemo shennitbaer:

Keli shemmeriqin letoko yayin mehechabit — lo yehaddeq bepiv qashshin veqissemin bechozeq, mippene sheddomeh limshammeret. Ap al pi sheenah meshammeret mammash, shehare oberim bah shemarim, mikkol maqom, hoil veyesh qissemin vetinnopet sheen oberim bah — hare zo doma limshammeret. Abal im hu yayin tzalul sheen bo tinnopet ella qissemin daqqin — muttar lesanneno apillu bimshammeret gemura, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Muttar laarot benachat mikkeli lachabero kede shehappesolet vehashshemarim yishshaaru beshule hakkeli. Ubilbad sheyyizzaher shekkesheyyapsiq haqqilluach umatchilin lered nitzotzot qetannot hannishshopot baacharona mittok happesolet — azay yapsiq veyannichem im hashshemarim, sheim lo yaaseh ken — hare nitzotzot ellu mokichim shehu borer. Abal bitchillat haeruy kesheen happesolet nikkar — lav borer hu. Velaken muttar liqlot shumman hatztzap al pi hechalab sheqqorin (shamatana) milmala, ukesheyyaggia samuk lechalab — yanniach qetzat mimmenna im hechalab. Vehu sheshshumman zeh tzarik leoklo bo bayyom, abal im eno tzarik lah — asur litroach mishshabbat lechol. Veim choshesh sheyyapsid o yitqalqel — muttar laasoto al yede nokri, mippene sheissur hattorach vehahakana mishshabbat lechol hu shebut middibre soperim, ubimqom hepsed yesh lehattir amira lenokri bekol shebut middibre soperim, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"z. Veim rotzeh leoklo lealtar — eno tzarik lehanniach mimmenna kelum im hacheleb. Veken hamareh mashqeh mikkeli lachabero — eno tzarik lehapsiq kesheyyoredin hannitzotzot. Shehare muttar libror okel o mashqeh mittok happesolet kesherotzeh leoklo o lishtoto lealtar, kol sheeno borer al yede keli ella beyado, kemo shennitbaer. Vekan ap shemmeareh mikkeli likli, mikkol maqom iqqar habberera naaseh al yede yadayv, veeno chashub borer bikli ella keshemmesannenen besudar o kepipa vekayyotze bahen:

Abal shumman hatztzap al gabbe hattabshil — asur laaroto kullo apillu kede leekol hattabshil lealtar, mippene shehen shene mine okalin, veoto hammin sheokel lealtar niqra okel vehashsheni niqra pesolet, ukeshemmeareh hashshumman sheeno rotzeh leoklo — hare zeh borer pesolet mittok okel:

Muttar lehagbiah hechabit al ezeh dabar kede sheyyeqalleach mimmenna hayyayin heteb. Veap sheal yede zeh yored yayin gam mittok hashshemarim — eno chashub keborer kol zeman sheen hannitzotzot matchilin lered mehashshemarim, kemo shennitbaer. Veken muttar litten mayim al gabbe shemarim shebbechabit sheyyiqletu taam hayyayin, veen bazeh mishshum borer, ubilbad sheyyishteh mehem bo bayyom:

En mesannenin et hachardal mehassubbin shello, ap al pi sheggam hem reuyim laakila veen hassubbin pesolet kelal veen bo mishshum borer min hattora — ap al pi ken asur middibre soperim, mippene shennireh keborer okel mittok happesolet, hoil umesannen kede leekol hachardal ulehashlik hassubbin. Abal im natan hachardal bamsannenet meereb shabbat — muttar litten bah betza letaqqen mareh hachardal hammistannen betokah. Ap al pi shehachelmon yored lematta im hachardal, vehachelbon shehu qashur nishar lemala im happesolet — eno nireh keborer okel mittok happesolet, mippene shehachelmon vehachelbon shenehem okalin hem, veeno mesannen hachelmon min hachelbon mechamat shehu chapetz leekol et hachelmon velo et hachelbon, ella mechamat shehachelmon moil letaqqen mareh hachardal velo hachelbon. Veap shemmashlik hachelbon im happesolet veokel hachelmon im hachardal, mikkol maqom, kevan shehassinnun eno bishbil haakila ella bishbil tiqqun hammareh — eno nireh keborer okel mippesolet, kevan shebbeemet shenehem min okel echad hem:

Veap im haya hassinnun bishbil haakila — lo haya asur ella kan, shehachelbon ap sheshshem okel alayv, mikkol maqom eno rauy leoklo kak kemot shehu, vegam regilin lehashliko im happesolet, laken hu nireh kipsolet legabbe hachelmon hanneekal kemo shehu im hachardal, veasur middibre soperim. Abal beinyan acher — en issur kelal, apillu middibre soperim, bibrerat min okel echad, dehaynu apillu borer chatikot qetannot mittok chatikot gedolot qetzat, ap al pi shemmashlik haqqetannot artza — enan nirin kipsolet bishbil kak, hoil vehen reuyin laakila uregilut hu leoklan:

Mayim sheyyesh bahem tolaim haasurim al derek shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman p"d — asur lesannenan apillu besudar, shehare i epshar kelal lishtotan belo sinnun, shemma yibla echad mehem. Abal muttar lishtotan al yede mappa, mippene sheen issur borer umeshammer ella bimtaqqen hainyan qodem akila o shetiyya sheyyihyeh rauy laakila o lishtiyya, shezzehu derek melaka, abal im bishat shetiyya meakkeb et happesolet shello yiknos letok piv — en zeh meen melaka, umuttar. Veen leesor mishshum sheriyyat beged zehu kibbuso, velo mishshum gezera shemma yischot, kevan sheddabar muat hu hannishreh bemayim kede lahanachat piv, ubedabar muat en lachush, kemo shennitbaer besiman sh"b. Ulehaoserin sham apillu bedabar muat mishshum sheriyyat beged zehu kibbuso — ap kan asur. Ukebar nitbaer sham shekkol baal nepesh yachmir leatzmo bemaqom sheepshar:

Im napelu zebubim lekos — lo yotzi hazzebubim lebaddan min hakkos, shehare zeh keborer pesolet mittok haokel, sheasur apillu kede leekol miyyad. Ella yiqqach gam min hammashqeh qetzat immahem, sheaz eno nireh keborer kelal, kemo shennitbaer lemala:

Hamchabbetz, dehaynu shelloqeach chalab venoten bo qeba kede lechabbetzo — chayyab mishshum borer, shehare hiprish haqqom min hechalab. Veken im natan haqqom betok keli gemi ume hechalab notepim mittoko — hare zeh toledet borer okel mittok happesolet al yede napa ukebara, vechayyab. Veap al pi shehaqqom vehechalab shenehem min okel echad veen kan pesolet kelal, ap al pi ken, hoil vehem debarim lachim shehem mitorbim yapeh vehu mapridan — yesh bazeh mishshum borer kemo bemaprid okel mippesolet:
Veim gibbeno vaasao gebina — chayyab mishshum boneh. Shekkol hamqabbetz cheleq el cheleq vedibbeq hakkol ad sheyyeaseh gup echad — hare zeh toledet boneh:
Notenin shumshemin veegozim lidbash, ubilbad shello yechabbetzem beyadayv:

Asur litten shemarim bemashqeh kede lehaamido, ap al pi sherauy lishtoto beshabbat, mippene sheal yede ken yoredin gam shimre hammashqeh atzmo leshule hakkeli, vahare zeh toledet borer, kemo hamchabbetz:

Haroqeq baruach veharuach mepazzer haroq — chayyab mishshum zoreh. Ulehaomerim shekkol melaka sheenah tzerika legupah patur aleha — ap kan patur, abal asur middibre soperim, apillu eno mitkavven lekak, ella shehu "pesiq resheh velo yamut":
